name: Allow people to hold Stories out of automatic dispatch
description:
Factory review recommendation 13 of 20.

## Context

Every Story entering an enabled Stage is currently eligible for dispatch, including work a person wants to handle manually.

## Acceptance criteria

- Define an explicit hold mechanism for individual Stories.
- Exclude held Stories from automatic dispatch and show why they are held.
- Allow releasing the hold to restore normal eligibility without losing Story or Stage Run context.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor plan review: Plan needs two revisions before implementation. Adopt ROW-58's canonical eligibility:{eligible:boolean,reasons:[{code,message,blockers?}]} shape; use code HELD and derive Waiting table text from reasons, no parallel waiting[] contract. ROW-58 owns eligibility.ts and blocked-link integration; you own hold persistence, hold/release commands and hold rendering. Required reason and surviving Stage changes are within Story scope. BUT optional hold beside a still-valid legacy stageRun is not compatible with docs/plugins/compatibility.md §3.4: old readers would silently erase a hold and unexpectedly resume dispatch. Do not document harmful hold loss as acceptable or merely add version:2 that old Zod drops. Propose safe storage: consider a separate Plugin-owned per-Story hold file that older versions never rewrite, or a versioned shape old schema rejects with explicit migration/test policy. Prefer the smallest solution that preserves holds and existing Stage Runs. Keep ADR-0043 provisionally for hold; recheck before publishing. Do not add new glossary Avoid words such as pause/lock/freeze globally unless necessary; lock is an existing core storage term. Return adjusted storage/interface plan before editing; TUI work must use rowbly-tui-design. ROWBLY.md remains proposed diff only.

comments.body: Supervisor decision: Revised plan accepted with separate per-Story hold.json and no Stage Run bag format change/migration. Canonical row field is eligibility and startRun rechecks it under the operation lock; ROW-58 owns eligibility.ts. Its implementation branch factory/row-58 is now pushed/being finalized: inspect it for interface reference, but base your task on main (no stack/merge companion branch without approval). Own holds.ts and hold/release registrations; minimally integrate heldReason with canonical eligibility once compatible. If ROW-58 lands first merge main; do not independently redesign its interfaces. Valid held and unreadable/future hold both fail closed; hold/release refuse unknown/invalid file bytes unchanged. Include doctor reporting for unreadable/unsupported hold via existing Plugin doctor mechanism, because compatibility policy requires unknown data be reported, and document any finding in guide/operating refs. Extend existing checks for hold surviving move and unchanged Stage Run, invalid/future bytes preserved, and a failing hook writing no partial hold. New v1 file has no migration so do not invent migration machinery. Required tests remain in existing homes and suite<=100. Read rowbly-tui-design for Story row. ADR0043 reserved; recheck. All four checks/manual scenarios and screenshots required. Proceed.
